When reporting a bug, please include:

1. **Steps to reproduce** — minimal HTML/JS or a link to a demo fork
2. **Expected vs actual behavior**
3. **Browser and OS**
4. **Lextrix version** — `Lextrix.version` in the console

Search [existing issues](https://github.com/rishureetesh/lextrix/issues) before opening a new one.

For feature requests, describe the use case and why it belongs in Lextrix core
vs application code.
